The '''Hard Heart Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] run by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Memah Roothes]]. It was a popular spot for [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and NCOs assigned to duty on the Death Star.

The Hard Heart was officially designated the Midlevel Cantina on [[Deck 69]] of [[Sector N-One/Legends|Sector N-One]]. When Memah Roothes was hired to run the bar, [[Gender/Legends|she]] changed the name in tribute to her previous cantina on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Soft Heart Cantina]]. Her friend [[Rodo]] served as the cantina's bouncer. It was destroyed with the rest of the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

The drinks served at the Hard Heart included:
*[[Alarevi ale]]
*[[Andoan ale]]
*[[A Walk in the Phelopean Forest]]
*generic and brand-name [[malt]]<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
*[[Mon Calamari seaweed mash]]
*[[Zabrak ferment/Legends|Zabrak ferment]]

==Layout==
The main room was more or less a square, with the east wall containing the bar itself and a small stage located beyond that in the northeast corner. On the opposite side of the northwest wall were unisex/unispecies [[Refresher/Legends|refreshers]] along with the manager's office. The north and south walls had exits, and an emergency exit was behind the bar.<ref name="DS" />

Twenty tables filled the room, bolted to slides attached to the floor. Each table had low-backed stools that could be adjusted for height. As many as five tables in any row could be slid together to accommodate a large party. The stools could be moved but could also be electronically held in place by the bartender, in case the patrons got rowdy and considered using the stools as weapons. Blowers and vacuums that could be controlled by the bartender or servers were built into the ceiling and tabletops.<ref name="DS" />
